decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane and follow the procedure in Article 36.2.
event_name: Date 30 June 2019 Time 12:39 2019 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 37), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: The front wing assembly has been changed while under parc ferme.
offence: Breach of Article 34.2 n) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane and follow the procedure in Article 36.2.
reason: As the front wing assembly was different to the one used during qualifying, it was replaced with the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate after a written request was made, per Article 34.2. As the part was changed while the car was in parc ferme, the competitor is required to start the race from the pit lane per Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
rules_referenced: Article 34.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 63 Change Of Frong Wing Assembly
